{'text': '就在宣布調高 Apple Music 月費後數星期，Apple 今日再宣布 Apple TV 服務同樣加價。公司向 9to5Mac 確認，Apple TV 月費將由 12.99 美元加至 14.99 美元。', 'source': "[0] Just weeks after announcing a price hike for Apple Music, Apple today announced another price increase for its Apple TV service. The company confirmed to 9to5Mac that Apple TV's monthly fee will increase from $12.99 to $14.99."}

{'text': 'Apple One 個人計劃月費同樣上調。', 'source': '[1] The Apple One Individual plan is also seeing a price increase.'}

{'text': 'Apple TV、Apple One 加價', 'source': '[2] Apple TV, Apple One price increase'}

{'text': '以下係今次加價嘅完整細節：', 'source': "[3] Here's the full breakdown of this price increase:"}

  • {'text': 'Apple TV（月費）：14.99 美元（原價 12.99 美元）', 'source': '[4] Apple TV (monthly): $14.99 (was $12.99)'}
  • {'text': 'Apple TV（年費）：119 美元（原價 99 美元）', 'source': '[5] Apple TV (yearly): $119 (was $99)'}
  • {'text': 'Apple One 個人計劃：21.95 美元（原價 19.95 美元）', 'source': '[6] Apple One Individual: $21.95 (was $19.95)'}

{'text': '其他 Apple One 計劃嘅價格維持不變。Apple 上月調高 Apple Music 價格時，一併調高咗 Apple One 家庭計劃同 Apple One Premier 計劃，但就未有調整個人計劃嘅價格。', 'source': '[7] Other Apple One plans remain unchanged. Last month, when Apple increased the price of Apple Music, it also raised the price of Apple One Family and Apple One Premier, but left the Individual plan at its old price.'}

{'text': '新收費即日起對新訂戶生效。Apple 表示，現有訂戶將於新收費生效前大約一個月收到加價通知。', 'source': '[8] The new pricing takes effect immediately for new subscribers. Apple says existing subscribers will be notified about the price increase roughly a month before it takes effect for them.'}

{'text': 'Apple 對上一次調高 Apple TV 價格係喺 2025 年 8 月，將月費由 12.99 美元加至 9.99 美元。當時 Apple 並無調整年費計劃或 Apple One 組合嘅價格。', 'source': "[9] The last time Apple increased Apple TV's pricing was back in August 2025, when the monthly fee went from $12.99 to $9.99. At that time, Apple did not adjust the annual plan or the Apple One bundle pricing."}

{'text': '過去一年，Apple 大幅擴充咗 Apple TV 嘅內容陣容。去年 10 月，Apple 宣布達成協議，成為一級方程式喺美國嘅獨家播映合作伙伴。F1 串流服務已包含喺 Apple TV 一般訂閱費用之內，毋須額外收費。', 'source': '[10] Over the past year, Apple has significantly expanded the lineup of content available on Apple TV. Last October, Apple announced a deal to become the exclusive U.S. broadcasting partner for Formula 1. The F1 streaming service is now included at no additional cost with a standard Apple TV subscription.'}

{'text': '今年較早時，Apple 亦將美國職業足球大聯盟（MLS）嘅串流服務加入 Apple TV，毋須額外收費。在此之前，用戶要訂購獨立嘅 MLS Season Pass 先可以收看 MLS 賽事。', 'source': '[11] Earlier this year, Apple also added streaming for Major League Soccer to Apple TV at no extra cost. Prior to this, users had to subscribe to the standalone MLS Season Pass to watch MLS matches.'}

{'text': 'Apple 近月亦有多個新節目叫好叫座，包括《足球女將》（Ted Lasso）第四季。Apple TV 今日就首播咗《黑暗物質》（Dark Matter）第二季。《慢馬》（Slow Horses）第六季亦將於 9 月 16 日開播。', 'source': '[12] Apple has also had several hit new shows in recent months, including Ted Lasso season 4. Apple TV today premieres Dark Matter season 2. Slow Horses season 6 also premieres on September 16.'}

{'text': '你點睇 Apple TV 嘅新收費？以 Apple TV 提供嘅內容計，14.99 美元算唔算合理？歡迎喺留言欄告訴我哋。', 'source': '[13] What do you think about this new pricing for Apple TV? Is $14.99 reasonable for what Apple TV offers? Let us know in the comments.'}

{'text': '我依家最推介嘅 Apple 優惠：', 'source': '[14] My top Apple deals right now:'}

  • {'text': 'AirPods Pro 3：199 美元（原價 249 美元）', 'source': '[15] AirPods Pro 3: $199 (originally $249)'}
  • {'text': 'AirTag 2：每個 20 美元起（原價 29 美元）', 'source': '[16] AirTag 2: starting at $20 each (originally $29)'}
  • {'text': 'M5 Pro MacBook Pro：2,899 美元（原價 3,199 美元）', 'source': '[17] M5 Pro MacBook Pro: $2,899 (originally $3,199)'}
  • {'text': 'AirPods Max 2：449 美元（原價 549 美元）', 'source': '[18] AirPods Max 2: $449 (originally $549)'}
  • {'text': 'Apple Watch Series 11：329 美元（原價 429 美元）', 'source': '[19] Apple Watch Series 11: $329 (originally $429)'}
